title: Deadlock beats Team Fortress 2's all-time peak 🔥
subject: deadlock
description:
Do you have a Deadlock invite yet? 👇

Valve's Deadlock peaked at 262,145 concurrent players on Steam on October 9, 2026, per SteamDB, passing Team Fortress 2's all-time peak of 253,997 from 2023. The record came as Valve added Solomon, a chess-themed hero. Deadlock is still an invite-only test.

Sources: SteamDB (Oct 9, 2026), PC Gamer (Oct 10, 2026), TheGamer via OpenCritic (Oct 10, 2026), Tech4Gamers (Oct 10, 2026)
Game images © Valve.
